2026_01_CLE_JAX.headline: Jacksonville can probe Cleveland’s replacement right guard before the Browns settle in
2026_01_CLE_JAX.paragraph1: The Browns ruled starting right guard Teven Jenkins out and list center Parker Brailsford as questionable, while the Jaguars have running back LeQuint Allen Jr. questionable. Cleveland’s immediate problem is continuity inside the offensive line, where rookie Austin Barber is expected to step in. Jacksonville can make that transition uncomfortable with interior movement and simulated pressure, then use field position to keep its offense flexible. The Browns need quick decisions and efficient early-down runs to stop the Jaguars from repeatedly attacking obvious pass situations.
2026_01_CLE_JAX.model_rationale: Jacksonville has a direct way to stress Cleveland’s altered interior protection, and that pressure point can shape both field position and the Browns’ available play menu.
